informal_statement:
For any real \(\lambda\), measurable curve
\[
\gamma:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R^2,
\]
and real \(a,b\), the strip density is integrable against the pushforward of Lebesgue measure on \([a,b]\).
reason: Source `CMVGeometry.lean:2243-2259`: The measurable-curve hypothesis and arbitrary real interval endpoints are retained; finite parameter measure suffices for bounded-density integrability.
